description: React component for managing workout programs in a gym management system. It allows trainers to list templates, assign programs to clients, create new programs, and generate program days based on date ranges or auto-generation. The component interacts with various API endpoints to fetch templates, clients, and programs, and to create and generate program days.

classes.name: ProgramBuilder
classes.description: React functional component for building and managing workout programs for clients.

methods.name: loadTemplates
methods.description: Fetches workout templates from the API and updates state.

methods.name: loadClients
methods.description: Fetches trainer's clients from the API and updates state.

methods.name: loadProgramsForMember
methods.description: Fetches existing programs for a selected member.

methods.name: createProgram
methods.description: Creates a new workout program for the selected member based on selected template and optional details.

methods.name: generateDays
methods.description: Generates program days for a specific program, either automatically or within a date range.
